cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: What Aren’t You Saying?
cards.instruction: Find out what someone is holding back by treating every careful answer as incomplete.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: These minutes say 'discussion of my proposal'. I trained you to record the decision, not just that mouths opened. What happened?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sign them and we can eat. Nobody wanted an awkward record.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've learned discretion. Now remember the part about names. Who wanted mine left out?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I did. I suggested someone else present, to save your proposal.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Better. You've supplied the person making the suggestion. Now finish the sentence: who replaces me?
